int_name: N MOUNT PLEASANT RD & SHERMAN ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a low-traffic residential or park-like setting that lacks dedicated sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass. While a stop sign and basic crosswalk markings are present, the lack of physical separation and potential sightline issues from dense vegetation reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no dedicated, paved space separated from vehicle traffic, requiring them to share the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Dense trees and vegetation near the intersection may obscure sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway curves

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians separated from the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse crosswalk markings to a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim trees and shrubs near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow, unmarked rural roadway with no dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. Pedestrians are forced to walk on the unpaved shoulder or in the travel lane, with dense vegetation potentially limiting sight lines.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian separation
hazards.description: No sidewalk or paved shoulder exists, forcing pedestrians to share the travel lane with motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible edge of the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: The absence of artificial lighting makes pedestrians difficult to see during dawn, dusk, or nighttime.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks or Paved Shoulders
interventions.description: Provide a dedicated, separated space for pedestrians to walk safely away from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add luminaires to improve visibility of pedestrians for drivers during low-light conditions.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow two-lane road in a wooded area with a complete lack of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, crosswalks, or streetlights, forcing pedestrians to share the travel lane with vehicles in an environment with limited sightlines due to dense vegetation.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: No sidewalk or paved shoulder exists, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the travel lane.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and trees grow right up to the road edge, limiting visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Absence of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is present, making pedestrians nearly invisible to drivers at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk or Multi-use Path Installation
interventions.description: Construct a dedicated, paved walking surface separated from the roadway to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install luminaires along the roadway to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back trees and brush from the road edge to improve sight distances and clear space for a potential shoulder.
